summary: Lloyds Banking Group filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 5,000,000 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at a VWAP of 99.8793 pence, as part of an existing buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026. The shares will be cancelled. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The programme runs under a previously disclosed mandate with no premium or deal structure. The filing is a routine market purchase disclosure, but is categorized as 'Capital Returns' because the buyback itself is a capital return event. Watch for continued execution and potential for programme increase or completion.
